items.title: Define the one fixed local M1_EURUSD_DEMO profile contract and its configuration hand-off
evidence: The local-only file contract is m1_eurusd_demo_profile.local.json beside the ignored T480 mt5.local.json. Its exact fields are profile_id, server, currency, symbol, and account_scope_sha256.
The fixed configure operation rejects a missing or malformed local profile and injects it only as FOREX_M20_ACCOUNT_EXECUTION_PROFILE into the prepared listener environment.

items.title: Enforce the profile before executable assessment and before execution reservation
evidence: t480/m20_demo_trading_session.py validates only M1_EURUSD_DEMO/GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD/EURUSD plus a sha256 account scope.

capture() invokes the profile check before symbol/candle assessment and rechecks it before the execution reservation boundary. A failure records the existing UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT_STATE pause and raises before reservation or order submission.
